verses.t: Woe to every scorner and mocker
verses.yusufAli: Woe to every (kind of) scandal-monger and-backbiter
verses.sale: Woe unto every slanderer, and backbiter

verses.t: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it
verses.pickthall: Who hath gathered wealth (of this world) and arranged it
verses.yusufAli: Who pileth up wealth and layeth it by
verses.rodwell: Who amasseth wealth and storeth it against the future
verses.sale: Who heapeth up riches, and prepareth the same for the time to come

verses.t: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal
verses.pickthall: He thinketh that his wealth will render him immortal
verses.yusufAli: Thinking that his wealth would make him last for ever
verses.rodwell: He thinketh surely that his wealth shall be with him for ever
verses.sale: He thinketh that his riches will render him immortal

verses.t: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher
verses.pickthall: Nay, but verily he will be flung to the Consuming One
verses.yusufAli: By no means! He will be sure to be thrown into That which Breaks to Pieces
verses.rodwell: Nay! for verily he shall be flung into the Crushing Fire
verses.sale: By no means. He shall surely be cast into al Hotama

verses.t: And what can make you know what is the Crusher
verses.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Consuming One is
verses.yusufAli: And what will explain to thee That which Breaks to Pieces
verses.rodwell: And who shall teach thee what the Crushing Fire is
verses.sale: And what shall cause thee to understand what al Hotama is

verses.t: It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled
verses.pickthall: (It is) the fire of Allah, kindled
verses.yusufAli: (It is) the Fire of (the Wrath of) Allah kindled (to a blaze)
verses.sale: It is the kindled fire of God

verses.t: Which mounts directed at the hearts
verses.pickthall: Which leapeth up over the hearts (of men)
verses.yusufAli: The which doth mount (Right) to the Hearts
verses.rodwell: Which shall mount above the hearts of the damned
verses.sale: which shall mount above the hearts of those who shall be cast therein

verses.t: Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them
verses.pickthall: Lo! it is closed in on them
verses.yusufAli: It shall be made into a vault over them
verses.rodwell: It shall verily rise over them like a vault
verses.sale: Verily it shall be as an arched vault above them
